name: THE HORSES
sceneryNote: Scenery until its lines are written (reference/hitching-post/brief.md): the pointer passes through to the mud under it, so it answers no verb and names nothing. Its LOOK and LISTEN lines go in the documents first; then this goes and a hotspot is laid over it.
note: Tyler, 2026-11-07, on Main Street: "maybe we add a hitching post front and center of the camera with a few horses tied to it so that it's not just a bunch of empty space?" Then, 2026-11-08, on the first group: "It just looks essentially like three copies of the same horse ... maybe one is eating? And are hitching posts that low? And I think they should all be moved quite a bit to the left". A hitching rail at chest height with three different horses -- a black with a blaze, a palomino eating hay, a paint pony in a striped blanket -- in the near mud between the letter-writer and the boundary men. Room-02 attempt 5.
